## Change

`src/count.js` gains a `--names` flag: it prints each fruit name on its own line and skips the count line entirely. The flag is checked first; the default path and `--list` path are byte-for-byte unchanged.

## Verified from the repository root

- `node src/count.js` -> `data/fruit.txt lists 8 fruit` (unchanged)
- `node src/count.js --names` -> 8 lines, fruit names only, no count line
- `node src/count.js --list` -> count line then each name (unchanged)
- `node --test` -> 1 pass, 0 fail

No edits under `shared/`; `docs/inventory.md` untouched since the count did not change.
